page.layout: Running head at top across the page: "Roma Irreconciliabilis." with page number 167 at right. One text column with a marginal note at the right of the column. Below the column a signature line "M 4" with catchword-like continuation "tificij,". No other blocks.

main_text.p: tas habenda sit ? Tutissimum ergo nobis illud erit semper Epiphanij, ὁ πνῶ ἐκ Μαρία, ὁ δὲ πνεῦμα ἡ ψυχὴ ἐκ ἀγίου πνεύματος προσκυνεῖσθω. NihilEp.haref.79. hic periculi est ; quin tuto li-ceat adire qui nos ad se vocat, Deum ; eiusque Christo benignissimo Seruatori, prouolui; Nullus Sanctorum, honorem hunc inuidit Deo ; nullus sibi aut arrogauit, aut passus est vnquam exhiberi ; Nec quis omnium est cui permisit Deus aut arripere hoc sibi, aut alijs communicare, aut ab alijs sibi forte communicatum serena fronte, animo æquo suscipere : In nostram ergo sententiam pedibus eant Pontificij,

page.notes: The Greek phrase is printed in the text and is partly illegible at this resolution; the Greek transcription is approximate. The marginal note "Ep.haref.79." sits beside the first paragraph. Section mark and small signs are uncertain.
